name: add-trial
description: Summarizes a clinical trial from uploaded reference attachments (PDF, slide deck, or images), routes it to the correct Notion oncology database (Early Stage or Metastatic, by disease setting), and creates a structured entry filling all schema properties and writing a detailed narrative page body. Also maintains the Trial Recall flashcard deck, keeping it in sync with both databases on add, on demand via /sync-flashcards, and on a weekly schedule.
